items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Milton and I were just saying a combination of things

ctx.x: Did you help him with the strings?

No indeed. The only person I helped, Miles happened to be with me one day and Milton Oreny, the composer - he had so many masters in music till he couldn't play or write. Some people study too much. Milton and I were just saying a combination of things and I mentioned about a tuba and I think that that thing, that sound that Miles got on a record, was an idea of me just thinking of instruments, and he called me back and thanked me.
Was this when Miles had that 9-piece group?
